![](/images/collaborations/Physalia-Logo-1000x358.png){width="35%" fig-alt="Physalia Courses logo"}

Bioconductor has partnered with [Physalia Courses](https://www.physalia-courses.org/) to offer co-branded training in bioinformatics and computational biology. These courses are taught by experienced instructors from the Bioconductor community and hosted by Physalia. Only the courses listed below are part of the Bioconductor–Physalia collaboration and eligible for free seats.

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)

workshops <- read_tsv("../../data/workshops.tsv")

# ---- Date parsing (same as main Workshops page) ----
determine_status_and_date <- function(date_str) {
  parsed_date <- NA_real_

  if (grepl("TBD|Early|Late", date_str, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    parsed_date <- as.Date("2099-12-31")
  } else {
    if (grepl("-\\s*\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}", date_str)) {
      # For ranges such as "24–28 March 2025"
      end_date_str <- str_extract(date_str, "\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$")
      parsed_date <- dmy(end_date_str, quiet = TRUE)
    }
    if (is.na(parsed_date)) parsed_date <- dmy(date_str, quiet = TRUE)
    if (is.na(parsed_date)) parsed_date <- my(date_str, quiet = TRUE)
    if (is.na(parsed_date)) parsed_date <- as.Date("2099-12-31")
  }

  status <- if (parsed_date >= today()) "upcoming" else "past"

  return(list(status = status, parsed_date = parsed_date))
}

# ---- Filter Physalia first (important!) ----
physalia_raw <- workshops %>%
  filter(initiative == "Physalia")

# Parse only Physalia rows → prevents length mismatch
parsed <- mapply(determine_status_and_date, physalia_raw$date, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

# Build Physalia table
physalia <- physalia_raw %>%
  mutate(
    status = map_chr(parsed, "status"),
    sort_date = map(parsed, "parsed_date") |> unlist() |> as.Date(),
    link_html = case_when(
      !is.na(workshop_url) & workshop_url != "" ~
        sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">View Course</a>', workshop_url),
      !is.na(previous_edition_url) & previous_edition_url != "" ~
        sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">View Previous Edition</a>', previous_edition_url),
      TRUE ~ "New Course"
    )
  )

# Split into Upcoming / Past
upcoming <- physalia %>%
  filter(status == "upcoming") %>%
  arrange(sort_date) %>%
  select(date, title, instructors, link_html)

past <- physalia %>%
  filter(status == "past") %>%
  arrange(desc(sort_date)) %>%
  select(date, title, instructors, link_html)

# Build tables
upcoming_table <- reactable(
  upcoming,
  compact = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  columns = list(link_html = colDef(name = "Workshop Link", html = TRUE))
)

past_table <- reactable(
  past,
  compact = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  columns = list(link_html = colDef(name = "Workshop Link", html = TRUE))
)

# ---- Combine like the main Workshops page ----
htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::h2("Upcoming"),
  upcoming_table,
  htmltools::h2("Past"),
  past_table
)
```

## Free Seats for Underrepresented Countries

Two free seats are available for each of the Bioconductor–Physalia courses listed above for participants based in low- or middle-income countries, as defined by the [World Bank's income classification](https://datatopics.worldbank.org/world-development-indicators/the-world-by-income-and-region.html).

[Apply here to be considered](https://forms.gle/w4UEBu3VrJXemtTN9)

## Learn More

Read the [blog post](https://blog.bioconductor.org/posts/2025-06-20-physalia-collaboration/) announcing the collaboration to learn more about how it came together and what it aims to achieve.
